channel.title: The Grant Desk - Fellowships, AI, Tech & Research, UK, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Fellowships, AI, Tech & Research, UK, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 10 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.title: IAPS: AI Policy Fellowship Spring 2027 (DC, London or remote)
item.description: Institute for AI Policy and Strategy (IAPS) · deadline 27 Sep 2026 · Fellows receive USD 18,000 and Senior Fellows USD 24,000 as a stipend for the three-month full-time program, plus an additional USD 3,000 stipend on the in-person DC or London tracks, healthcare benefits and a USD 500 professional development stipend. Up to 45 fellows. No application fee.

item.title: Brooks International Fellowship Programme 2027 (Tate Britain x Delfina Foundation)
item.description: Tate, in collaboration with Delfina Foundation · deadline 21 Oct 2026 · Fully funded 6-month fellowship: living allowance bursary of GBP 40 per day, single bedroom at Delfina Foundation (house of up to 8 residents with shared facilities), return economy flight, UK airport transfers, visa fee reimbursement with visa support, London Underground and bus travel pass, a research resource allowance, and travel to other Tate galleries (Tate Modern, Liverpool, St Ives) and other UK and European cultural institutions. Two fellowships available. No application fee.

item.title: LASR Labs Winter 2027 (London AI Safety Research)
item.description: LASR Labs, hosted at the London Initiative for Safe AI (LISA) · deadline Closed 20 Sep 2026 · GBP 15,000 stipend for the 13-week programme, plus food, office space, and flights/travel. No application fee.

item.title: ILIAD Fellowship: Mentored AI Alignment Research (November and December 2026 cohorts)
item.description: ILIAD · deadline Closed 21 Sep 2026 · USD 6,000 per month travel-and-housing allowance for the 3-month fellowship. No tuition or application fee.

item.title: MATS Residency Program: 6-24 Month Funded AI Safety Research (Winter 2027 intake)
item.description: MATS (ML Alignment and Theory Scholars) · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · USD 155,000 to 285,000 per year gross (set by location, seniority, and experience), plus medical/dental/vision/life insurance, retirement plan, paid time off, conference funding, catered meals, and up to USD 25,000 relocation support. No application fee.

item.title: Anthropic Fellows Program (funded AI research fellowship, January 2027 cohort)
item.description: Anthropic (with Constellation as recruiting partner) · deadline Rolling / undated · USD 3,850 / GBP 2,310 / CAD 4,300 per week for four months of full-time research, plus roughly USD 15,000 per month in compute funding and other research expenses. No application fee.

item.title: ERA:AI Fellowship 2027 (Winter cohort, Cambridge)
item.description: ERA Fellowship · deadline Closed 13 Sep 2026 · GBP 10,000 stipend for the 10-week fellowship, plus visa support, travel expense coverage and meals during working hours. Top performers can receive 6+ month extensions through the Research Scholars programme. No application fee.

item.title: 2 new AI, Tech & Research fellowships - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• BOLD Fellow, British Open-ended Learning and Discovery Lab
    https://eng.ox.ac.uk/jobs/job-detail?vacancyID=187853
    University of Oxford, Department of Engineering Science (BOLD Lab, with UCL and Imperial College London) · deadline Closed 15 Sep 2026 · Salary on Oxford Grade 10R, GBP 65,336 to GBP 84,663 per year, with the posting noting that further salary options are being explored. Benefits include associate membership at Reuben College, 38 days annual leave, pension scheme, childcare services, and travel expenses for stakeholder and conference visits. Fellows also get access to substantial compute: 3 million GPU hours on Isambard for the first 18 months, with the lab working towards 5,000 H100-equivalents in total across industry and government support. No application fee.
  • ILIAD Intensive: Foundational AI Alignment Program (London and Berkeley)
    https://www.iliad.ac/intensive
    ILIAD · deadline Rolling / undated · No tuition. USD 5,000 travel and housing allowance per participant, plus office space at the venue and lunch and dinner five days a week. Cohorts of 15 to 30 participants. Participants arrange and pay for their own travel and accommodation out of the allowance.

item.title: 1 new AI, Tech & Research fellowship - week of 17 Aug 2026

item.title: 1 new AI, Tech & Research fellowship - week of 15 Jun 2026
item.description:
• GovAI UK Winter Fellowship 2027 - Research Track
    https://www.governance.ai/post/winter-fellowship-2027-research-track
    Centre for the Governance of AI (GovAI) · deadline Closed 12 Jul 2026 · £12,000 salary for the three-month term, plus travel support to London and weekday lunch provided. Visa sponsorship (3-month temporary work visa) available. No application fee.

item.title: 1 new AI, Tech & Research fellowship - week of 01 Jun 2026
item.description:
• Oxford Institute for Ethics in AI: Accelerator Fellowship Programme 2026/27
    https://afp.oxford-aiethics.ox.ac.uk/join
    Institute for Ethics in AI, University of Oxford · deadline Closed 15 Jun 2026 · Monthly stipend of GBP 2,000 to support accommodation, travel, food and living expenses. Economy airfare to and from the UK and any visa costs covered. Project-related costs (workshops, seminars, public exhibitions/events) considered case-by-case if a clear proposal and brief cost justification are included in the application. No application fee.

item.title: 1 new AI, Tech & Research fellowship - week of 18 May 2026
item.description:
• British Council 90th Anniversary Research Fellowships at IASH 2027 (Edinburgh)
    https://www.iash.ed.ac.uk/british-council-90th-anniversary-research-fellowships
    Institute for Advanced Studies in the Humanities (IASH), University of Edinburgh, in partnership with the British Council · deadline Closed 31 Jul 2026 · GBP 2,500 per month bursary for 12 months, plus travel expenses, dedicated office space, University of Edinburgh email and library access, a University mentor, weekly Fellows' Lunch, work-in-progress seminars, full calendar of Institute and College events, and opportunities to participate in or design funded workshops and colloquia. No application fee.

item.title: 2 new AI, Tech & Research fellowships - week of 04 May 2026
item.description:
• Understanding Society Data Research Fellowships (May 2026 call)
    https://www.understandingsociety.ac.uk/research/fellowships/call-fellowships/
    Understanding Society (Institute for Social and Economic Research, University of Essex) · deadline Closed 27 May 2026 · Up to £70,000 per fellowship for staff costs and dissemination-related activities (no indirects). Salary, NI and pension funded at 100% for research-only contracts; for research-and-teaching contracts the fellowship funds backfill at the most junior lecturer point. Third-sector applicants additionally get £5,000 of an academic collaborator's salary covered.
  • Serpentine: Future Art Ecosystems R&D Fellowship - Art x Convergence (2026-2027)
    https://www.serpentinegalleries.org/whats-on/future-art-ecosystems-rd-fellowship-art-x-convergence/
    Serpentine Arts Technologies (Future Art Ecosystems) · deadline Closed 07 Jun 2026 · £10,000 award per fellow (4 fellows: individuals or collectives), plus travel and accommodation support for the three London intensives, plus specialist seminars, workshops and structured peer learning through the cohort.

item.title: 1 new AI, Tech & Research fellowship - week of 27 Apr 2026
item.description:
• Pivotal Research Fellowship (2026 Q3)
    https://www.pivotal-research.org/fellowship
    Pivotal Research · deadline Closed 03 May 2026 · £6,000 to £8,000 stipend + travel to London + £2,000 housing for non-London fellows + weekday lunch and dinner + compute. Extensions of up to 6 months with continued financial support, mentorship, management and workspace (70 to 90% of fellows in recent cohorts received extensions).
